queries.name: Meeting scheduling records with non-existent tenants
queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meeting_booking_events ms WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tenant t WHERE t.name = ms.tenant)

queries.name: Uncompleted outbox events older than 5 minutes
queries.query: select count(*) from outbox_events where status <> 'completed' and created_at < now() - interval '5 minutes' and created_at > now() - interval '3 days'
